text.tspan: Death rate from outdoor air pollution in 1990 vs. 2023
Deaths from outdoor particulate matter air pollution per 100,000 people. Countries below the diagonal line
have experienced an increased death rate, whilst those above the line have seen a decreased death rate.
Death rate in in 2023 (deaths per 100,000 people)

tspan.tspan: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized.
